# Extended Parameter Ablations and Operational Details

This appendix provides the complete empirical ablation tables referenced in Chapters 2–4—covering the `nsa_flow` trade-off weight $w \in [0.01, 0.95]$, in-fold subject row-mean removal and deterministic ICA initialization, fine-grained quantile sparsity $q \in [\text{None}, 0.90]$, the $1,214$-configuration `ADNI-MCI` grid sweep, synthetic per-regime breakdowns, and pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests—followed by computational complexity bounds.

## Computational Complexity Summary

| Operation | Complexity per Iteration | Memory Footprint | Inner-Loop Factorization Required? |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **`nsa_flow` Retraction Step** | $\mathcal{O}(p_m k^2)$ | $\mathcal{O}(p_m k + k^2)$ | None (1 Gram product + 2 $[p_m,k]\times[k,k]$ products) |
| **Polar Consensus Update ($\mathbf{U}$)** | $\mathcal{O}(N k^2 + k^3)$ | $\mathcal{O}(N k)$ | $k \times k$ Sylvester polar factor ($k \ll N$) |
| **Forward / Backward Pass** | $\mathcal{O}(N p_m k)$ | $\mathcal{O}(N k + p_m k)$ | None |

: Computational and memory complexity of the `SiMR` and `nsa_flow` primitives. {#tbl-app-complexity}
